get.summary: Read the learner-safe content snapshot for a pinned version

x-contract.answerProtection: public item fields only; no grading rule or answer value

get.summary: Read the protected assessment snapshot owned by content-service

x-contract.answerProtection: rule metadata and sealed rule reference only; raw answer values never cross the event boundary

get.summary: Resolve a future content read without rewriting active or historical facts

x-contract.recovery: exact immutable snapshot first; safe fallback only for future reads; never regrade a historical attempt

post.summary: Start an assessment session pinned to an immutable content snapshot

x-contract.pinRule: server resolves and persists the contentVersionId/contentEpoch/snapshotHash pin

x-audit.logBoundary: Only correlation, authorization decision, immutable pin identifiers and outcome codes may be logged; protected rules and answer-bearing values are prohibited.

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same subject, content pin and request hash return the original session

get.summary: Read an assessment session without exposing grading rules

x-contract.answerProtection: session state and learner-safe items only

x-audit.logBoundary: Session reads are learner-safe; raw responses, protected drafts and sealed rule references must not enter audit payloads or logs.

post.summary: Submit an attempt; the server owns scoring and emits attempt.submitted

x-contract.rawResponse: accepted only at the protected scoring boundary; never persisted in event payload or logs

x-audit.logBoundary: Only submissionId, submissionDigest, immutable pin and version metadata may cross audit/event boundaries; raw candidate responses and answer rules are prohibited.

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same submission digest returns the original attempt and assessment status

put.summary: Persist a protected pre-submission draft at the canonical assessment-session boundary

x-contract.protectedDraft: Encrypted or otherwise protected at rest; it is readable only by the session owner and scoring boundary and is never emitted to Outbox, analytics or logs.
x-contract.terminalWrite: SUBMITTING, COMPLETED, AUTO_SUBMITTED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED reject with 409; a checkpoint never creates or changes an attempt/report fact.
x-contract.optimisticConcurrency: baseStateVersion is compared to the server state; If-Match, when supplied, must encode the same base state version.

x-audit.logBoundary: Audit and operational logs may contain only sessionId, checkpointVersion, clientEventId, clientSeq, checkpointDigest, state version and authorization decision; protectedDraft response bodies and rules are prohibited.

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: The same sessionId, checkpointVersion and checkpointDigest returns the original checkpoint acknowledgement without changing state.

200.description: Checkpoint saved or same-version/same-digest replay acknowledged

put.summary: Deprecated compatibility adapter for the canonical session checkpoint

x-contract.checkpoint: Legacy attempt-scoped cursor is translated only when it can be bound to the same pre-submission session draft; it never mutates a final attempt/report result.
x-contract.unsupported: A missing pre-submission session, any terminal session or a digest/state mismatch returns 409.

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same checkpoint digest returns the original checkpoint version

get.summary: Read an immutable deterministic assessment report snapshot

x-contract.report: replayable from assessmentVersion and content snapshot pin
x-contract.answerProtection: learner-safe outcome summary and mistake codes only; assessment does not return or own mastery

x-audit.logBoundary: Reports expose only learner-safe assessment summaries. Raw responses, answer rules and learning-service mastery facts are prohibited from report logs and audit payloads.

x-contract.contentPin: each item retains its source content version pin

post.summary: Complete a review action through learning-service

x-contract.assessment: only assessment-service may produce assessment result facts

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same queue item and action digest return the original projection version

get.summary: Read the current mastery projection for an item

x-contract.historicalSource: assessment event; no direct assessment table read

B10Forbidden.description: Resource owner, policy or content rights denied

B10Conflict.description: Idempotency, state version or content pin conflict

B10ContentUnavailable.description: Pinned content is unavailable and no safe recovery exists

B10AssessmentItemRulePin.description: Per-item immutable answer-rule metadata. The fields identify a sealed rule contract and are not answer values.

B10ReasonTrace.description: Learner-safe structured explanation trace. It cannot include candidate response text, an answer key or a sealed rule value.

B10ObjectiveOutcome.description: Learner-safe deterministic objective outcome. It is an assessment fact, not a learning-service mastery or SRS fact.

B10SelfRatingOutcome.description: Learner self-rating only. It deliberately has no objectiveNumerator, objectiveDenominator or scoreBucket.

B10ManualReviewOutcome.description: Manual-review outcome status only. A pending or subjective review cannot be represented as an objective score.

B10AssessmentOutcome.description: Discriminated assessment outcome. Only the OBJECTIVE branch carries an objective score summary.

B10CandidateResponse.description: Closed candidate-response union. The protected scoring boundary accepts only these explicit response forms.

B10ContentVersionPin.description: Content pin for a future read or a task that has not started. SAFE_FUTURE_FALLBACK may be represented only before a session or attempt starts; active session and attempt projections use B10ActiveSessionAttemptPin and never replace their pinned contentVersionId silently.

B10ActiveSessionAttemptPin.description: Immutable pin used after an assessment session or attempt starts. The contentVersionId/contentEpoch/snapshotId/snapshotHash identity never changes. Emergency rights, security or legal removal returns UNAVAILABLE instead of a silent fallback.

B10RuleContract.description: Protected grading contract metadata. It is not an answer key and is never emitted in integration events.

B10AssessmentContentSnapshot.description: Assessment-only snapshot. Content service remains the owner of question definitions and protected rule references; assessment does not maintain a content master table.

B10ContentRecovery.description: Future-read-only recovery decision. The route cannot be applied to an active session or attempt. SAFE_FUTURE_FALLBACK requires an explicit replacement version and snapshot and never regrades historical facts.

B10CreateAssessmentSessionRequest.description: The client may request a content version but cannot provide tenant, owner, role, score or grading rule facts.

B10AssessmentSession.description: Session lifecycle only. Attempt and report lifecycles are distinct aggregates and cannot be inferred from this status.

x-p1r-state-machine.statusSeparation: session status never aliases attempt.status or report.status

itemRulePins.description: Learner-safe immutable answer-rule version/digest pins; the sealed rule reference and answer value are not exposed.

B10AttemptSubmission.description: Closed protected candidate-response union. The scoring boundary receives one explicit response shape and a digest; client score/rule authority is rejected.

B10Attempt.description: Assessment attempt lifecycle only. It does not own learning mastery, SRS, reward or progression state.

x-p1r-state-machine.statusSeparation: attempt status never aliases session.status or report.status

B10ProtectedDraft.description: Protected pre-submission candidate draft. It must be encrypted or equivalently protected at rest and is never emitted to Outbox, analytics or logs.

B10AssessmentSessionCheckpointRequest.description: Canonical session checkpoint command. baseStateVersion, checkpointVersion and client sequence are concurrency facts; protectedDraft is not an assessment submission.

B10AssessmentCheckpoint.description: Canonical session-level checkpoint acknowledgement. It is not an attempt or report fact.

B10CheckpointRequest.description: Deprecated attempt-scoped checkpoint adapter request. New callers use B10AssessmentSessionCheckpointRequest.

B10Checkpoint.description: Deprecated attempt-scoped checkpoint adapter acknowledgement. It is not the canonical session checkpoint.

B10AssessmentReport.description: Versioned assessment report. It is bound to one session, attempt and submission, and never owns mastery/SRS facts.

x-p1r-state-machine.statusSeparation: report status never aliases session.status or attempt.status
